# LinkedIn copy — SAIFCORE alignment

**Owner paste only.** Agents do not edit LinkedIn. Keep this file in sync with site `meta.ogTitle` / hero failure-mode spirit.

**Goal:** win qualified inbound — Senior Backend / Payments / Tech Lead roles and freelance payment-integration briefs — without inventing metrics or leading as a generic Java CV.

**Sources of truth:** `messages/en.json`, `messages/fr.json`, `saifcore-alignment-prompt.md`

Do **not** invent metrics, subsidiary counts, or “zero drift in production” claims. Synapse / Bank of Africa stay delivery context.

---

## Strategy (why this copy)

| Layer      | Job                                                                   |
| ---------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Headline   | Claim + search keywords recruiters actually type                      |
| Role line  | Credibility (BoA via Synapse) + open-to signal                        |
| About hook | Named failure modes → you own the hard problem                        |
| Expertise  | Outcomes and decision ownership, not a stack dump                     |
| Experience | Same claim in role bullets — scannable proof for hiring managers      |
| Posts      | Teach one failure mode → inbound from operators and tech leads        |
| ICP        | Who should message; who you are not for                               |
| CTA        | Qualify the brief so replies are usable                               |
| Replies    | Convert inbound in under 5 lines without sounding available-to-anyone |

**Opportunity filter:** every block should make a hiring manager or client think “this person has already lived our worst payment incident” — not “another Java CV in Dakar.”

## 3. About — EN (ready to paste)

```text
I make money flows stay correct when the rails fail — double callbacks, provider timeouts mid-transfer, transactions stuck between states, reconciliation that drifts. That is the work. Happy-path demos are not.

I am a payment & API engineer delivering banking and payment platforms for Bank of Africa Group as a consultant through Synapse Groupe. Before that, payment products at ENG Technologie Groupe. I started in business management software — I still design for operators and auditors, not only for engineers.

Expertise I bring into a team or engagement:
• Payment correctness — Wave, Orange Money, Free Money and banking rails; idempotency, settlement, reconciliation, and failure handling under real PSP behavior
• API platforms — design, security and governance for partners: versioning, OAuth2/JWT, rate limiting, gateways, onboarding, documentation that partners can ship against
• Backend systems — Java/Kotlin and Go on AWS; distributed services built for auditability and consistency wherever money moves

Who this is for:
• Banks, fintechs and operators in UEMOA who need payment and multi-entity API flows hardened to the bar international partners expect
• International product and platform teams entering West Africa — or hiring a senior engineer who already knows how mobile-money-first payments fail in production
• Hiring managers filling remote Senior Backend / Payments Engineer or Technical Lead seats where payments, APIs, or reliability are the core of the role — not a side ticket

How I work: named senior ownership, written scope, production depth. Public proof and ways of working: saifcore.tech

Open to remote Senior Backend / Payments Engineer and Technical Lead roles, and to freelance payment-integration or API-hardening work.

Message me with role + stack + payment/API scope, or with the corridor, PSP, and failure mode you need fixed. I reply when it is a real fit.
```

## 7. Expertise posts (publish 1× / week; EN or FR twin)

Goal: attract operators and hiring managers who recognize the failure mode. End with a soft CTA — no hard sell, no invented metrics.

### Post A — Double callback (payments)

```text
Payment bugs that cost money rarely show up in the happy-path demo.

They show up when the PSP sends the same callback twice — and your system treats both as truth.

What I design for first on West Africa rails (Wave, Orange Money, Free Money, banking):
1. Idempotency keys that survive retries and replays
2. Explicit state machines (so “stuck between states” is visible, not silent)
3. Reconciliation that explains drift instead of hiding it

I deliver banking and payment platforms for Bank of Africa Group as a consultant through Synapse. Public notes and cases: saifcore.tech

If you are hiring for Senior Backend / Payments / Tech Lead — or need a corridor hardened — send role + scope, or corridor + PSP + failure mode.
```

### Post B — API platforms for partners (hiring / platform teams)

```text
An API that “works in Postman” is not a partner platform.

Partners need: versioning they can plan against, OAuth2/JWT that ops can rotate, rate limits that protect the core, gateways that route multi-entity traffic, and docs a third party can ship from.

That is the work I do on banking and payment APIs — including multi-subsidiary delivery context at Bank of Africa Group via Synapse.

If your role is Senior Backend, API / Platform, or Tech Lead with real partner surface area, message role + stack + API scope. Proof of approach: saifcore.tech
```

### Post C — Open to the right briefs (opportunity signal)

```text
What I am looking for (remote):

• Senior Backend / Payments Engineer or Technical Lead where payments, APIs, or reliability are the core of the role — not a side ticket
• Freelance / contract: payment integration or API hardening on UEMOA rails, or for teams entering mobile-money-first markets

What I am not looking for: generic CRUD greenfield with no money-movement risk, or “full-stack everything” seats where payments are someone else’s problem later.

 cred: Bank of Africa Group platforms via Synapse · prior payment products at ENG · Wave / Orange Money / Free Money in production context · saifcore.tech

Message with role + stack + payment/API scope — or corridor, PSP, and the failure mode you need fixed.
```

**FR note:** Prefer EN for international recruiter reach; post FR when targeting UEMOA operators. Same structure; do not invent KPIs in either language.

## 8. Inbound reply templates (owner paste in DM)

### Recruiter / hiring manager

```text
Thanks — happy to look if payments, APIs, or reliability are central to the role.

Please send: role title, stack, location/remote policy, and the payment or API scope (PSPs, corridors, multi-entity, or partner surface).

I am Consultant Backend Engineer at Synapse on Bank of Africa Group platforms; Senior describes the level of work. Profile + proof: saifcore.tech
```

### Freelance / operator brief

```text
Thanks for reaching out.

To see fit quickly, send: corridor or product, PSP(s), and the failure mode (double callback, timeout mid-transfer, stuck state, reconciliation drift, partner API, etc.).

I reply within two business days with fit and a realistic start signal. How I engage: saifcore.tech
```

### Soft decline (wrong fit)

```text
Appreciate the note — this one sits outside payment/API correctness work I take on.

If a later role centers on money flows, PSPs, or partner APIs, feel free to resurface with scope. saifcore.tech
```
